<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Details"><b>Details</b></span></h2>
<p><b>Clean water</b> is one of the most vital items that widely involved in most activities in the game, including hydration of the Main character, as well as involved in many crafting schemes. It is a good reason to keep some spare of this essential item in your inventory.
</p><p>Relieving the thirst without any side effects, is the main reason this item being the best choice of common water that existed in the wasteland.
</p>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Obtaining"><b>Obtaining</b></span></h2>
<p>There are plenty of options for survivors to gather <b>clean water.</b> Listed below are most of the known methods of obtaining clean water.
</p>
<ul><li>The most basic one is the by filtering <a href="/wiki/Dirty_Water" title="Dirty Water">dirty water</a> using a <a href="/wiki/Water_filter" class="mw-redirect" title="Water filter">water filter</a>.</li>
<li>Clean water can be found in <a href="/wiki/Hospital" title="Hospital">hospitals</a> as well as <a href="/wiki/Bandit_city_forts" title="Bandit city forts">military bandit bases</a>, <a href="/wiki/Intact_house" title="Intact house">intact houses</a>, <a href="/wiki/Clinic" title="Clinic">clinics</a>, and <a href="/wiki/Pharmacy" title="Pharmacy">pharmacies</a>.</li>
<li>When searching in <a href="/wiki/Mountains" title="Mountains">mountains</a>, survivors have a chance to find a stream and they can collect clean water from it.</li>
<li>Clean water can also be collected during <a href="/wiki/Weather_events" title="Weather events">rainy weather</a>. Survivors must have a cooking utensil to enable this action. In addition, survivors can also get clean water by boiling extracted <a href="/wiki/Ice" title="Ice">ice</a> from frozen bodies of water during <a href="/wiki/Weather_events" title="Weather events">winter</a>.</li>
<li>The most expensive way of gathering clean water is through the <a href="/wiki/Water_purifier" title="Water purifier">water purifier</a>, which required <a href="/wiki/Coal" title="Coal">coals</a>, gasoline, and another prerequisites.</li></ul>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Trivia"><b>Trivia</b></span></h2>
<ul><li>In old versions, clean water is originally called pure water.</li>
<li>In older versions, clean water has expiration date of 7 days and when it's not used, it will turn into dirty water.</li>
<li>In older versions, a bottle of clean water can be used for 5 times which is similar to alcoholic beverages in their previous state.</li></ul>
